research.title: Synthetic data you can evaluate.
research.problem: A benchmark comparing LLM-based and GAN-based approaches to synthetic tabular data generation.
research.solution: GReaT, SDG-3k, and CTGAN-3k were evaluated with an XGBoost classifier using 3,000 synthetic rows.
research.results: GReaT reached 93.53% accuracy, followed by SDG-3k at 87.67%, Original at 87.46%, and CTGAN-3k at 82.83%.
